By-products are listed but are not reused automatically; separate lines may therefore use more machines than an optimized recycling layout. Provide sufficient belts and pipes. How the calculation works

Machines = target items per minute ÷ (recipe output per minute × clock speed / 100), rounded up. Batch mode divides quantity by minutes and estimates steady-state throughput; startup, transit time and complete crafting cycles can affect the finishing time. All installed machines run at your selected clock speed for capacity figures. The suggested balanced clock sets every machine to the same speed to match the target. Rates below the game's 1% minimum require intermittent operation. Alternate recipes must be unlocked in-game. The catalog includes all standard and alternate crafting recipes with item or fluid outputs in the official wiki’s stable dataset, including FICSMAS and manual-only recipes. Build Gun construction, Customizer patterns, and fuel burning without item output are outside this production calculator. Fluid rates use cubic metres. Select any recipe output, including by-products. Choose “Custom recipe” for mods or a custom production rate.
